integrity: The proof uses the source only for its displayed type isomorphisms and publication classification, states the classical cardinality ingredient explicitly, narrows the originality claim to the specialized Bullet consequences, and makes no claim of independent or formal verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to sound extensional Set-valued semantics whose arrow types are full function sets. It does not exclude domain-theoretic, relational, realizability, presheaf, or other categorical semantics, nor Set-based semantics with restricted function spaces.
title: Full-function Set semantics admits only the terminal generalized Bullet type
